attributes.name: Blessing of the Demon Queen
attributes.powers:
After you acquire or play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile does not have the Lamashtu trait, you are dealt 1d4 Mental damage that cannot be reduced.

Discard this card to add 3 dice to any check.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d6 to your checks.
